title: Cartoon Slip (Slide Whistle)
blurb: Slide whistle down, bonk at the bottom. Physical comedy's oldest and most reliable piece of audio grammar, and the mechanism is almost embarrassingly simple: the descending whistle makes a promise about where this is going, the impact keeps it, and the audience is laughing before anything has actually landed. Animation spent a century testing this so nobody else has to. Apply it to genuine slips, to metaphorical descents, to any graceful failure caught on camera. It also works beautifully over a plan collapsing in slow, dignified stages.
origin: The classic slide-whistle-and-impact of cartoon pratfalls.
